title: Mockingbird Essay
description: You will write a literary analysis essay examining Harper Lee's "To Kill a Mockingbird." Your essay will present a clear, arguable thesis exploring a specific aspect of the novel while demonstrating your technical proficiency in modern document creation and formatting.
